name: Fergus Fínbél
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fergus Fínbél served as the poet of the Fianna. He acted as an advisor to Fionn Mac Cumhaill. He had less skill and less rank than the beloved Oisín. Some sources name Fionn Mac Cumhaill as his father.
